description: This file contains the implementation of an immutable JSON Patch class, providing methods to create, parse from JSON, and serialize JSON Patch objects, along with standard object methods.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonPatch
classes.description: Immutable implementation of JsonPatch providing creation, parsing, and serialization functionalities.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new ImmutableJsonPatch with specified operation, path, and optional value.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to create an ImmutableJsonPatch object, throwing exceptions on invalid input.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Returns the operation type of the JSON patch.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path of the patch.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the value associated with the patch, if any.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the patch to a JSON object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the JSON string representation of the patch.
